info.name: Sonatype Lifecycle Public REST Advanced Search SPDX API

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Enter the applicationId for the application you want to generate the SBOM(s).

params.name: scanId
params.description: Enter the scanId of the application scan.

params.name: format
params.description: Enter the format for the SBOM(s) to be generated.

params.name: generateCycloneDx
params.description: Set to `true` to generate an equivalent CycloneDx SBOM. Both SBOMs will be combined as a tar.gz archive.

params.name: spdxVersion
params.description: Enter the desired SPDX version, possible values are 2.2|2.3

items.docs:

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Enter the applicationId for the application you want to generate the SBOM(s).

params.name: stageId
params.description: Specify the stageId for the application evaluation. Allowed values are `develop`, `build`, `stage-release`, `release` and `operate`.

params.name: format
params.description: Enter the format for the SBOM(s) to be generated.

params.name: generateCycloneDx
params.description: Set to `true` to generate an equivalent CycloneDx SBOM. Both SBOMs will be combined as a tar.gz archive.

params.name: spdxVersion
params.description: Enter the desired SPDX version, possible values are 2.2|2.3

items.docs:
Use this method to generate SBOM(s) based on the latest application evaluation report at the specified stage.

Permissions required: View IQ Elements
